The narrative that fentanyl precursors enter the U.S. solely through small mail parcels is incomplete. In reality, a primary pipeline involves industrial diversion. Legitimate chemical importers purchase these precursors under the guise of legal manufacturing (such as for pharmaceuticals or industrial goods). However, internal actors within these supply chains illicitly divert these raw materials, smuggling them across the border to clandestine labs in Mexico. This 'legitimate front' makes detection significantly more difficult than traditional smuggling.

The bit about customs clearance into the US is totally incorrect. I work in the industry and I deal with this stuff everyday. If a package is destined to Mexico it clears customs in Mexico, not the US, except in certain circumstances which typically do not apply to small parcels for consumers/residential delivery. 

If a shipment to Mexico from China moves through the US in transit to Mexico, it moves under a “bond,” which means it’s mostly likely put onto a “bonded” truck and trucked into Mexico from there. A bond is a special document that allows a shipment to move through the US without officially entering into United States commerce. Once the shipment reaches its destination in Mexico it will be released from its bond and cleared through Mexican customs. Why would US Customs be clearing customs for goods entering Mexico? That makes no sense. That’s what Mexican customs is for.

5:23 That's not accurate. De minimis doesn't mean the package skips customs, it means the receiver (or shipper) doesn't pay import fees or duties. Everything entering the country has to go through customs, regardless of value. If de minimis meant packages skip customs entirely, cartels would just send a bunch of packages as low-value, but I've had numerous packages from Canada, France, Germany, and the UK that were opened and searched by customs before being released they were valued at around $20-100. The de minimis value is $800 but Trump tried to get rid of the de minimis exemption. I'm not sure if he succeeded but I still haven't had to pay import fees or duties for anything imported that was under that threshold.
